name: bran
description: Compile structured story events into executable narrative packages and audit their branching mechanics.

interface.shortDescription: Compile and validate branching story packages
interface.longDescription: Turn grounded source events and world rules into validated NarrativePackages with typed actions, multi-seat visibility, replay variants, runtime and downstream handoff contracts, deterministic settlement, and reproducible receipts.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use $bran to compile and validate this executable branching story package.
